description: Lists files in the Directus file library (directus_files) with filtering, sorting, field selection, search and pagination, returning their metadata rather than their binary contents. Use import_data to load rows from a CSV or JSON file, and get_collection_items for files referenced from a content collection. Returns at most 25 files unless limit says otherwise. Each entry carries the file id, filename, type, size and storage location, which is what an asset URL is built from.
name: get_files
